title: Runtime and memory of the deployed rule against processed graph size

quantities.processed_edges_millions: edges processed by one execution of the deployed rule on the instance under the implemented scheduling (millions)
quantities.wall_time_seconds: synchronized wall time of that execution after warm-up, mean over the post-warm-up repeats (s)
quantities.peak_memory_gib: peak accelerator memory of that execution (GiB)

notes: One instance per timed graph: a full benchmark graph or a registered subgraph of the scaling sweep, named by the instance key. Timed with the E17 sessions of cm_campaigns.timing inside completed GPU allocations; the peak memory is read with torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated after a reset before each timed execution, and the processed-edge count is the operator's own count of the edges it visits. The timing rows, memory readings and scheduler exports go under raw/; deposit with `python -B scripts/export_records.py from-mapping --mapping <runtime_scaling mapping>` once the set is registered for the mapping exporter.
